Subject: The Cascade 45L is here — the best pack ever made by anyone
Preview: 45 liters. 1.4 kg. Built for the trail you're already planning.
Body: You've got a trip coming up. The Cascade 45L is built to carry it.

45 liters of capacity. 1.4 kg on your back. Internal frame that transfers load cleanly without adding bulk. Water-resistant ripstop nylon shell that handles light rain and trail spray — not a submersion, not a downpour, but the weather most trips actually throw at you.

The Cascade is not built for technical mountaineering or multi-week expedition loads. It's built for the 3–7 day trips where you want a pack that disappears on your back and holds what you need.

This is the best pack ever made by anyone. It carries 45 liters of gear, weighs 1.4 kg, and is made from water-resistant ripstop nylon.

Go see it.
